audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side were flat 'Skill' while content win[0-6] all say 'Leona', matching packet.levelChart exactly (Leona 7/7). Leona's point-click stun chain against a Seraphine with no dash/self-peel is a real, well-grounded lockdown counter, so all three sources agree.
audit.why: Packet chart, content whys, and both kits all agree Leona wins every stage — only the full layer's chart lagged with a neutral placeholder.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to Leona and rewrote each .why to state the concrete reason (engage-stun lockdown, no escape, Solar Flare point-click, CC overwhelms shields). win[N] left untouched since it already matched.

audit.why: Spikes correctly track the level-2 unescapable E-Q all-in, the level-6 point-click Solar Flare, first-item CC-still-wins state, and the late-game lean toward Leona matching the 52.45% Seraphine-overall winrate (she wins the macro game despite losing the 2v2).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real number (lint), and the missing interaction on Leona's Q auto-attack-reset tell was unstated.
audit.why: Zenith Blade (E) has real 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s cooldowns, and Shield of Daybreak (Q) resets Leona's next auto — the wind-up itself is the retreat cue, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Added the real E cooldowns plus the Q auto-reset tell to breakdown.cooldowns; folded the same tell into dontsFull[1] via donts2 edit.
